scope: Exactly these edits in test_run_records.py: the parameters ("Jürgen@x.org" NFC, "Jürgen@x.org" NFD) and ("straße@x.org", "STRASSE@x.org") become ("Jürgen@x.org", "JÜRGEN@X.ORG") and ("JÜRGEN@X.ORG", "jÜrgen@x.org"), and test_one_email_in_different_unicode_forms_is_one_owner becomes test_one_email_in_different_cases_is_one_owner; test_a_fold_that_decomposes_is_still_one_owner becomes test_a_decomposed_character_is_another_owner, asserting that a composed and a decomposed "ΐ" are two owners.
reason: E5 P1 spec D6 and §9 (owner decision 2026-11-05, PR #1634 and #1648 reviews): the owner key is the email trimmed and lowercased with str.lower(), as aigateway's account key, with no case folding and no NFC. Folding merges distinct addresses (ß/ss, ﬁ/fi, ſ/s) into one owner, and the key is the only check on every Run read and write. The edited cases asserted folding and NFC equivalence.
